Package backend.database

Class JDBCTest

java.lang.Object
backend.database.JDBCTest
public class JDBCTest extends Object
The JDBCTest class provides a collection of methods for performing queries with the POS database, including CRUD operations for drinks, employees, inventory, and receipt reports.

It srves as a database helper for connected to the PostgreSQL backend defined in Database.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Maira

    • getZReportSummary

      public static ZReportSummary getZReportSummary(LocalDate date)
      Generates a Z report summary for the specified date. Aggregates order counts, total sales, tax, payment breakdowns, and associated employee names for receipts on that date.
      Parameters:
      date - the target date for the report; if null, uses today's date
      Returns:
      a ZReportSummary containing sales and employee data for the day
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs

    • getProductUsage

      public static List<ProductUsageRecord> getProductUsage(LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate, int limit)
      Retrieves product usage data within a specified date range. Calculates the total quantity of each inventory item used across all drinks and orders within the period (inclusive).
      Parameters:
      startDate - the start of the date range; if null, pull from endDate
      endDate - the end of the date range; if null, pull from startDate
      limit - the maximum number of products to return
      Returns:
      a list of ProductUsageRecord objects representing ingredient usage
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs

    • upsertInventory

      public static boolean upsertInventory(Inventory inv)
      Updates an existing inventory item or inserts a new one if it doesn't exist. Automatically marks items as low stock when their current amount is below the threshold.
      Parameters:
      inv - the Inventory object containing item details
      Returns:
      true if the record was updated or inserted successfully; false otherwise
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs

    • restockItem

      Increases the stock quantity of a specified inventory item. Also updates its low stock status based on the new quantity.
      Parameters:
      item - the name of the inventory item to restock
      amount - the quantity to add (negative values are ignored)
      Returns:
